title: A domain is a boundary: every statement and affirmation exists only relative to it, and zooming into fire finds all the elements again (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
The process here is different. but the essential element is --- a domain is a boundary. Every statement only exists relative to that boundary. This work on SDE meant that I could only assign a category when I could see how it related to what was around it. 

An affirmation cannot be made without context. And It only exists within that context. I can flag an element as "fire" in one context.... but when I zoom into only the fire elements... I find all the elements again within that context

sections.label: Source
